title: Local LLMs on 2x Arc Pro B70

panels.title: Cluster: GPU layout and model servers
Configured layout
panels.description: The GPU layout `make mode` picked (gateway/llama-swap/layouts/mode): split = one Qwen per card, tp2 = one Qwen across both cards, review = Qwen on card 0 and Gemma on card 1, big = gpt-oss-120b across both cards.

panels.title: Running layout
panels.description: What the running containers add up to. Green: the configured layout. Amber: something else, e.g. during a layout switch, while qwen-image holds card 1 ("+qwen-image"), or "mixed" when no layout fits (a container still starting or crashed). Red: the Docker API did not answer.

panels.title: Card 0 (PCI 03:00.0)
panels.description: Model container(s) running on card 0 and the model each serves. Grey = free. A container counts from the moment it starts, before its model has loaded.

panels.title: Card 1 (PCI 08:00.0)
panels.description: Model container(s) running on card 1 and the model each serves. Grey = free. A container counts from the moment it starts, before its model has loaded.

panels.title: Layout exporter
panels.description: Whether layout-exporter could inspect every model container through the docker-api proxy in its last poll. Red with no data: the exporter itself is down.

panels.title: Model servers running
panels.description: Each running model container's serving config, read from its launch command (docker inspect): TP = --tensor-parallel-size; Context = --max-model-len (vLLM) or --ctx-size (llama.cpp, shared by the slots); Slots / max seqs = --max-num-seqs (vLLM) or --parallel (llama.cpp); Quant = --quantization, else read from the weights' name; KV cache dtype = --kv-cache-dtype (vLLM, auto = the model's dtype) or --cache-type-k/-v (llama.cpp). Empty = not set or not applicable. Health = the container's healthcheck (starting while the model loads).

panels.title: Generated tokens/s (5 min)
panels.description: Tokens generated per second across every model on both cards, averaged over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Prompt tokens/s (5 min)
panels.description: Prompt tokens read per second across every model on both cards (including tokens served from cache), averaged over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Total power
panels.description: Both B70s together.

panels.title: Combined memory bandwidth
panels.description: Memory read bandwidth of both B70s together.

panels.title: Generated tokens/s by model (stacked)
panels.description: Each model's generation rate, stacked: the top edge is the total across both cards. TP=2 shows as one model on both cards.

panels.title: Power, both cards (stacked)
panels.description: Each card's power, stacked: the top edge is the total draw of both B70s.

panels.title: Memory bandwidth, both cards (stacked)
panels.description: Each card's memory read bandwidth, stacked: the top edge is the combined bandwidth.

panels.title: Card 0 busy (last hour)
panels.description: Share of the last hour card 0 (PCI 03:00.0) was reading more than 5 GB/s from memory, i.e. running prefill or decode.

panels.title: Card 1 busy (last hour)
panels.description: Share of the last hour card 1 (PCI 08:00.0) was reading more than 5 GB/s from memory, i.e. running prefill or decode.

panels.title: GPU activity: memory read bandwidth
panels.description: Best proxy for GPU load: decode is limited by memory bandwidth and prefill reads the weights too. Near zero means the card is idle.

panels.title: Requests running per card
panels.description: Requests each model server is working on, by the card(s) it runs on (vLLM, and llama.cpp for Gemma and gpt-oss). 0+1 is Qwen with TP=2 or gpt-oss.

panels.title: Decode speed
panels.description: Average per-request generation speed (tokens/s) over requests finished in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: First token (median)
panels.description: Median time from request arrival to first streamed token. Dominated by prompt processing for long agent contexts.

panels.title: MTP tokens per step
panels.description: Mean tokens produced per decoding step with MTP speculative decoding (1 = no speedup, 5 = max with 4 draft tokens).

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache instead of being recomputed.

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description: Share of the KV cache currently holding active requests.

panels.title: Requests running
panels.description: Requests vLLM is processing, across all Qwen instances (4 per card, 8 with TP=2).

panels.title: Token throughput (all requests)
panels.description: Tokens per second across all requests. Prompt tokens split into freshly computed vs reused from the prefix cache.

panels.title: Per-request decode speed
panels.description: Average generation speed of individual requests finishing in each interval (1 / time per output token).

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: End-to-end request time, including thinking and the full answer.

panels.title: Prefill vs decode time per request (median)
panels.description: Where request time goes: processing the prompt vs generating the answer.

panels.title: Prompt size per request
panels.description: Prompt length in tokens. Coding agents typically send 15-40k tokens.

panels.title: MTP acceptance by draft position
panels.description: How often each drafted token is accepted. Code is typically 80-95%; prose falls off quickly by draft 3-4.

panels.title: Decode speed
panels.description: Average generation speed while Gemma was generating, over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Prompt speed
panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second of prompt processing, over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: MTP tokens per step
panels.description: Mean tokens produced per decoding step with Gemma's MTP draft head (1 = no speedup, 4 = max with 3 drafts).

panels.title: Requests running
panels.description: Requests Gemma is processing (2 slots).

panels.title: Gemma token throughput
panels.description: Tokens per second Gemma generated and read. Empty outside the review layout.

panels.title: Gemma MTP acceptance by draft position
panels.description: How often each token Gemma's MTP head drafts is accepted (3 drafts per step).

panels.title: Requests completed (24h)
panels.description: Qwen requests that finished in the last 24 hours, across all vLLM instances.
